realized_prompt_policy: Every model-call record stores SHA-256 of canonical JSON messages; response text is not part of public milestone artifacts.

debater_propose.text: Propose an independent program as debater {index}.

debater_revision.text:
Review the programs and visible checks, then return a revised complete program:
{summaries}

evolution_planner.text: Suggest mutation and crossover strategies for program search; do not write a program.

evolution_propose.text: Use non-spatial evolutionary {mode} to propose one new complete program. Parents and visible checks: {parents}

orchestrator_assign.text:
Assign one worker revision using only these programs and visible-check results. Return a concise instruction, not a program:
{summaries}

orchestrator_plan.text: Return JSON with a 'plans' array of distinct solution strategies. Do not write the final program. Number of plans: {k}

worker.text: Implement this plan as a complete program: {plan}
